claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: EMD-386088 is a brain-penetrant 5-HT6 receptor agonist with no reported cytotoxicity; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak antiproliferative signal reflecting non-specific lipophilic/lysosomotropic stress rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
